title: items[].output of 03-receipts-to-json
description: The result for one image: the receipt in the receipt shape ($defs/receipt), how it was validated and which models were tried. The receipt of a validated item can be used as is; the receipt of an item that needs review is the best attempt, as a starting point for a person.

outcome.description: validated: all checks passed for the receipt below. needs_review: no model produced a receipt that passes; the item is also written to needs_review.jsonl.

attempts.description: In order: ppocr-v6 always, paddleocr-vl only when ppocr-v6 failed validation. `receipt` is what that model alone produced, so the strategies 'OCR only' and 'hybrid' can both be scored from one run.

note.description: Why there is no receipt: the error code of the fallback call, e.g. model_locked on an account without the paid pool.

source.description: Where a value was read. `lines` are indices into the model's output: the lines of ppocr-v6, or the `order` of the layout blocks of paddleocr-vl (a table block gives one box for all its rows).

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels of the image, around all the lines.

confidence.description: Lowest line confidence; null for paddleocr-vl, which reports none.

receipt.description: Amounts are numbers in the unit printed on the receipt (6000 for a printed 6.000 rupiah, 471.24 for $471.24); a field the document does not show is null.

date.description: ISO 8601 date of the document (not the due date).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, only when the document prints a code or an unambiguous mark.

currencyMark.description: The mark as printed, e.g. $ or Rp.

discount.description: Positive number, however the document prints it.

sources.description: Provenance of the single-valued fields, keyed by field name; a field that is null has no entry.
